generatedProse.practice-connection:
You now have a way of working that will serve you well beyond this course. Each experience you examine, each judgement you weigh against a standard, each plan you commit to and carry into the next task is this discipline at work. The habit to keep is simple: look back honestly at what you did, weigh it against the standard you are working toward, and let it shape what you do next.

That same habit carries into professional life. Wherever you are expected to review your own practice, account for it and keep developing, the people who keep getting better are the ones who reflect critically and can show, in writing, that they do. The discipline you have just practised is one you will use long after you graduate.
